title: GEDI Forest Height
description: Forest canopy height measured by the GEDI lidar on the International Space Station, shown on a globe that turns once. The plucked melody follows the average height of the visible forest: it climbs when the Amazon, Congo and Southeast Asian rainforests face you and rests over open ocean. A forest chorus swells with how much tall forest is in view.

legend.meaning: mean canopy height of visible vegetation, A3 = 14.0 m, A5 = 24.0 m
same mean for the upper, middle and lower third of the globe, 0-30 m over 2 octaves
control: canopy height x forest cover in view
control: share of the visible globe that is ocean
control: share of vegetation taller than 25 m
silent: not measured by this dataset

data_source.music: pixel inversion of the SVS movie with the SVS 0-50 m colorbar
